description: The consumer's systemd journal shipped to the site's Loki by the NixOS baseline's journal client, through logging's push-only receiver on tcp/3101.

dropUnits.description: Units whose journal lines never leave the VM, on top of the platform's generate-.*-secrets.* — the units that read or write the module's own secrets. Unit-name patterns (regex): letters, digits, _ . * @ - only.
dropUnits.changeNote: The journal client is rewritten whole by update-os.sh on every OS update (/etc/nixos/tappaas-logging.nix) and applied by that rebuild; alloy reloads its config in place. No downtime for the module.

securityPaths.description: Files or directories of the module whose changes are recorded as security events while the site's security monitoring is on (ADR-050): its own configuration or state that nothing but TAPPaaS should change. Absolute paths of plain characters; a path the guest does not have is left out. Beside the platform's own (/etc/secrets, /root/.ssh, /etc/ssh).
securityPaths.changeNote: Written into the journal client's fragment (/etc/nixos/tappaas-logging.nix) at the next OS update and applied by its rebuild. NixOS guests only.
